verdict.rationale: Column does not document any official SDKs. A Column engineer said customers prefer the HTTP APIs over SDKs. Column does publish an official OpenAPI spec (confirmed live by probe) and tells users to generate type-safe client SDKs from it in any language, so building against SDKs works only through self-generated clients. Missing for 10: first-party maintained SDKs in major languages, SDK documentation and versioning, independent corroboration of SDK use.
